# Example: W3C Validation

#### Course: Learn HTML

## Example: W3C Validation

Let's now fix the errors in this code.

```html
1<!DOCTYPE html>
2<html>
3<head>
4    <title>Programiz PRO</title>
5</head>
6<body>
7    <h1>Welcome to the Learn HTML course</h1>
8  <p>You cannot insert a horizontal line, <hr> inside a paragraph.</p>
9    <img src="image.jpg">
10</body>
11</html>
```

Fixed Code

```html
1<!DOCTYPE html>
2<html lang="en">
3
4<head>
5    <title>Programiz PRO</title>
6</head>
7<body>
8    <h1>Welcome to the Learn HTML course</h1>
9    <p>You cannot insert a horizontal line inside a paragraph.</p>
10    <img src="image.jpg" alt="W3C Validation Example Code">
11</body>
12</html>
```

Here, we have

- removed the <hr> tag from inside the <p> tag.
- included the alt attribute inside the img tag.
- added the lang="en" attribute to specify that the language of this webpage is English.

Now when you run this code through the W3C validator, you will see the following result.

![W3C Validator message after fixing the error.](data:image/png;base64,)
